entries.said: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
entries.quote: When we look at the next six months, we've already spoken about where we are looking at the overall year going. We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year.
entries.speaker: Amit Syngle
entries.delivered: Full year FY26 revenue growth was reported at 4.9% with annual revenue of Rs 35,584 crore.
entries.evidence: Annual table: Mar 2026 revenue growth of 4.9%.

entries.said: It's good to maintain 18-20% margin as we go ahead.
entries.quote: Given all this, it is okay to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band. I would not qualify whether it should be at an 18% level or a higher level. But it's good to maintain 18-20% margin as we go ahead.
entries.speaker: Amit Syngle
entries.delivered: Full year FY26 EBITDA margin was reported at 19.0%.
entries.evidence: Annual table: Mar 2026 EBITDA margin of 19.0%.

entries.said: The company expects to achieve high single-digit volume growth in the band of 8-10% going forward.
entries.quote: we are still confident that demand conditions should continue giving us closer to high single-digit volume growth in the band of about 8 -10%, as we predict going forward.
entries.speaker: Amit Syngle
entries.delivered: H1 FY27 volume growth was reported at 8%, and Q2 FY27 standalone volume growth was 6.4%.
entries.evidence: Call c5 reported metrics: H1 FY27 volume growth of 8% and Q2 FY27 volume growth of 6.4%.

entries.said: The company expects to commission the first phase of the VAM-VAE backward integration project in the first half of the year.
entries.quote: we expect to commission first phase in the first half of this year. The VAM-VAE project will bring to us very strong innovation capabilities
entries.speaker: Amit Syngle
entries.delivered: Commissioning of the first phase in H1 FY27 cannot be explicitly verified from standalone financial tables.
entries.evidence: Mentioned as project milestone; requires operational confirmation from future qualitative disclosures.

entries.said: Gross margins are expected to be in the band of 41% to 43% in the second half.
entries.quote: This band of about 41% to 43% would really be the band we should be looking forward to.
entries.speaker: Amit Syngle
entries.delivered: H2 FY27 period has not concluded yet, so gross margins are not yet reported.
entries.evidence: Call c5 guidance for future H2 FY27 period.

summary: Management guidance on margins and annual growth has been reasonably reliable, with FY26 ending within targeted band expectations. Future volume and project milestones remain open for full verification.
business: Asian Paints manufactures and sells paints, coatings, and home decor products. Segments include decorative coatings, international business, and home improvement offerings.
bull: Full year FY26 revenue returned to positive growth of 4.9% with an annual revenue of Rs 35,584 crore.
FY26 EBITDA margin achieved 19.0%, staying squarely inside the guided 18-20% band.
Strong top-line expansion in Q1 FY27 with consolidated revenue growing by 18% YoY to Rs 10,542 crore.
bear: Standalone volume growth slowed to 6.4% in Q2 FY27, trailing earlier full-year volume ambitions.
Borrowings increased over the last three balance sheets from Rs 2,290 crore to Rs 4,596 crore.
Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin dropped to 15.6%, missing the typical 18-20% guidance band for that quarter.
